name: financetracker-ios
description: FinanceTracker iOS App - Expense, Debt & Investment Analyzer

scripts.build:qa: echo 'Static app - no build needed' && cp -r QA/* www/
scripts.build:uat: echo 'Static app - no build needed' && cp -r UAT/* www/
scripts.cap:init: npx cap init FinanceTracker com.financetracker.app --web-dir www
scripts.deploy:qa: npm run build:qa && npm run cap:sync
scripts.deploy:uat: npm run build:uat && npm run cap:sync

author: FinanceTracker Team
